title: Far Overhaul Binding Rule Vs Class Deviation
question: Answer current question: Far Overhaul Binding Rule Vs Class Deviation?
bluf:
EO 14275 (Apr. 15, 2025, 90 FR 16447) orders the FAR cut back to what statute requires or what sound procurement still needs. OMB M-25-26 (May 2, 2025) splits the work into two clocks: **Phase I class deviations now**, **Phase II notice-and-comment later** under 41 U.S.C. § 1707.

Acquisition.gov issues model deviation text part by part. Agencies adopt it by class deviation. The FAR Companion and buying guides are **non-mandatory**. They are not the FAR.

FR Doc. 2026-12559, 91 FR 37550 (June 23, 2026), is **one of twelve proposed rules** (FAR Case 2026-001). Comments closed July 23, 2026. A final rule was **not retrieved at cutoff**.

EO 14402 pushes fixed-price as the default. EO 14398 writes a DEI-ban clause into contracts and calls compliance material for the False Claims Act. Neither order repeals Title 41. Neither order is the FAR.

This is the buying rulebook under the payment record. Defend the Spend can show a payment. It cannot show whether the award was made under the old FAR, a class deviation, or a rule that has not yet been issued.
evidence_cutoff_note: Object-local cutoff from the accepted root-overhaul action. Parent and subject dates do not refresh it.
use_note: Private canonical root object created by the authorized R11 transaction; read the source before reuse.

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains both the original public view and a crawler-friendly static HTML reading edition. public_full_text is true.
availability_semantics.public_machine_data: The public site contains the complete positively selected structured dataset. public_full_text is true; reading_url and data_url identify the canonical JSON object.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. public_full_text is false and access_state is private_by_design. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
